messages:
Priya Sharma: quick weekly check — Acme account. noticed the new model rollout (v4-open-opt) adoption jumped to ~42% of traffic since tuesday, but fallbacks spiked. Can we surface numbers and any regression flags?
Jesse Liu: saw that too. metrics i pulled: overall token usage +11% w/w, spend +9%. fallback rate jumped from ~1.4% to 7.8% yesterday.
Ava Cole: 95p latency for routed requests to the new model is 420ms vs 260ms on baseline model. error rate (5xx) for v4-open-opt is 2.1% vs 0.4% baseline.
Priya Sharma: yikes. do we know if fallbacks are because of model OOMs, rejects, or runtime timeouts?
Miguel Torres: ops-bot just flagged a capacity autoscale event at 2023-11-14T03:24:12Z. looks like several pods hit OOM kill and then traffic fell back to v3-quant. logs show `CUDA out of memory` traces for sequences >1024.
Ava Cole: confirmation: evaluation harness shows a small subset of prompts causing long context >1.5k tokens, and v4-open-opt hasn't had the sequence length tuning applied in their rollout.
Jesse Liu: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) enable auto-fallback cap per request to prefer lower-latency model earlier 2) push sequence length limiter to client until we patch 3) raise dedicated pool for Acme for a few hours. thoughts?
Priya Sharma: propose we notify ACME: "we're seeing higher fallbacks and latency for the new model; route policy adjusted to limit exposure; investigating." want to give them expected timeline. any ETA to apply kernel/patch?
Miguel Torres: infra can ramp a temporary dedicated pool within ~45 minutes if they approve. runtime team estimates a patch (sequence-length cap + better mem path) in ~8-12 hours, deploy after QA.
Ava Cole: QA found a regression in KV cache allocation that amplifies OOMs under long context; patch should cut fallback by ~60% in our sims.
Priya Sharma: ok. i'll draft the customer note and ask for approval to spin up dedicated pool. please +1 if you agree.
Jesse Liu: +1 — do it. include the fallback numbers and the short-term steps.
Miguel Torres: +1 — i'll start the pool prep and keep you posted.
Priya Sharma: thanks. action items: (1) Priya to send customer-facing brief in 20m, (2) Miguel to start dedicated pool if approved, (3) Ava/Jesse to schedule the runtime patch and postmortem notes. Will reconvene tomorrow morning for status. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: opened incident INC-2023-ACME-FALLBACK assigned to infra; priority=P2; link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2023-ACME-FALLBACK
Priya Sharma: noted. if anyone has more logs or a narrow prompt set producing the long contexts, please drop them here or DM. "`select * from prompts where tokens > 1200 and account = 'acme'`" might help query.
Jesse Liu: attaching quick SQL snippet to get sample prompts (will share off-thread).
Ava Cole: i'll run a small eval to estimate expected P95 after patch and post numbers here.
Priya Sharma: great. thanks team — i'll post the customer note shortly.
